answer: The naive design trusts every attestation; this one samples 5% of submissions per epoch and recomputes them from source. A replay caught in the sample claws back the reward and the bond. Each claim is re-checked by a juror with nothing to gain, so a lantern held by the farm's own clones lights nothing. Cost is one recomputation per sampled claim, about 2% of total work. A zephyr of new identities does not escape the sample, and a jetty of vested balance is what a caught farm loses.
